barbell_bench_flat: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down before you unrack.
Feet planted, slight arch, glutes stay on the bench.
Lower the bar to your lower chest with elbows about 45° from your body.
Press up and slightly back, wrists stacked over your elbows.
barbell_bench_incline: Set the bench to 30–45° and keep your shoulder blades pinned back.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, just under the collarbones.
Keep your elbows slightly tucked, not flared straight out.
Press straight up over your shoulders and keep your hips down.
barbell_bench_decline: Lock your legs under the pads before you take the bar.
Lower the bar to your lower chest with control.
Keep your shoulder blades back and down on the bench.
Have a spotter help you unrack and rerack the bar.
barbell_floor_press: Lie with knees bent, feet flat and shoulder blades pulled together.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, then pause briefly.
Keep your elbows about 45° from your body.
Press up without bouncing your arms off the floor.
barbell_bench_close_grip: Grip about shoulder-width, a little narrower than your usual bench.
Keep your elbows close to your sides as you lower.
Touch your lower chest, then press by straightening your elbows.
Wrists stay straight and stacked over your elbows.
barbell_bench_spoto: Set up as for a regular bench press.
Lower the bar and stop it 2–3 cm above your chest.
Hold the pause without letting the bar sink or your back relax.
Press from the pause with no bounce.
barbell_row_overhand: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, torso at about 45° or lower.
Grip overhand, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar to your upper stomach, leading with your elbows.
Lower under control without standing up between reps.
barbell_row_underhand: Hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees.
Grip shoulder-width with your palms facing up.
Pull the bar to your belly button, elbows close to your sides.
Lower until your arms are straight without rounding your back.
barbell_row_pendlay: Start each rep with the bar resting on the floor.
Keep your torso close to parallel with the floor and your back flat.
Pull the bar fast to your lower chest, then set it back on the floor.
barbell_row_seal: Lie face down on a high bench so your arms hang straight.
Keep your chest on the bench for the whole set.
Pull the bar up toward the bench, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower until your arms are fully straight.
barbell_landmine_row_two_arm: Straddle the bar and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Hold the bar just behind the plates, or use a V handle.
Pull toward your chest without changing your torso angle.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.
barbell_landmine_row_one_arm: Stand beside the end of the bar, feet staggered, back flat.
Brace your free hand on your knee or a bench.
Pull the bar to your hip, elbow close to your body.
Keep your shoulders square; don't twist to finish the rep.
barbell_meadows_row: Stand side-on to the end of the bar in a staggered stance.
Grip the thick end overhand and rest your other forearm on your knee.
Drive your elbow up and back, past your torso.
Lower to a full stretch without rounding your back.
barbell_overhead_press: Start with the bar on your front shoulders, hands just outside them.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so you don't lean back.
Pull your head back slightly to clear the bar, then press straight up.
Finish with the bar over your mid-foot and your arms locked.
barbell_seated_press: Sit with your back against an upright pad and your feet planted.
Lower the bar to chin or upper-chest height.
Press straight up without arching away from the pad.
Keep your forearms vertical under the bar.
barbell_push_press: Start with the bar resting on your front shoulders.
Dip a few centimeters at the knees with your torso upright.
Drive hard with your legs and use that push to press the bar overhead.
Lock out over your mid-foot, then lower the bar to your shoulders.
barbell_landmine_press: Hold the end of the bar at shoulder height in one hand.
Stagger your stance and brace your abs.
Press up and forward along the bar's arc until your arm is straight.
Lower under control without twisting your torso.
barbell_upright_row: Grip about shoulder-width or a little wider.
Lift the bar close to your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop near lower-chest height, elbows no higher than your shoulders.
Lower slowly, keeping the bar close to you.
barbell_shrug: Stand tall with the bar in front of your thighs and your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower all the way down.
Don't roll your shoulders or bend your elbows.
barbell_back_squat_high_bar: Rest the bar on top of your traps, not on your neck.
Take a breath and brace your abs before you descend.
Sit down between your heels with your knees tracking over your toes.
Keep your torso fairly upright and drive up through your whole foot.
barbell_back_squat_low_bar: Set the bar lower, across the back of your shoulders.
Squeeze the bar hard to keep your upper back tight.
Sit your hips back, with more forward lean than in a high-bar squat.
Keep the bar over your mid-foot for the whole rep.
barbell_front_squat: Rest the bar on your front shoulders, close to your throat.
Keep your elbows high so the bar doesn't roll forward.
Squat straight down with your torso upright.
Drive up leading with your elbows and chest.
barbell_zercher_squat: Hold the bar in the crook of your elbows, hands together.
Keep the bar close to your body and your chest up.
Squat down between your knees with your abs braced.
Stand up without letting your upper back round.
barbell_overhead_squat: Hold the bar overhead with a wide grip and locked elbows.
Push up into the bar and keep it over your mid-foot.
Squat with your chest up and your hips between your heels.
Start light: shoulder and ankle mobility usually limits the load.
barbell_landmine_squat: Hold the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, leaning slightly into the bar.
Squat down between your knees with your chest up.
Drive up through your whole foot.
barbell_split_squat: Take a long stance with the bar on your upper back.
Drop your back knee straight down toward the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your torso upright.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch.
barbell_squat_bulgarian: Rest the top of your back foot on a bench behind you.
Stand far enough forward that your front knee tracks over your foot.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot; the back leg only helps you balance.
barbell_reverse_lunge: Start standing tall with the bar on your upper back.
Step back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep most of your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
barbell_walking_lunge: Step forward into a long stride with your torso upright.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive up and bring your back leg through into the next step.
Keep your feet about hip-width apart for balance.
barbell_deadlift_conventional: Bar over your mid-foot, shins close, hands just outside your legs.
Pull the slack out of the bar and brace before it leaves the floor.
Push the floor away, keeping the bar against your legs.
Stand tall with hips and knees locked; don't lean back.
barbell_deadlift_sumo: Take a wide stance, toes turned out, bar over your mid-foot.
Grip inside your knees with your arms hanging straight.
Push your knees out over your toes and keep your chest up.
Spread the floor with your feet and bring your hips forward to finish.
barbell_deadlift_romanian: Start standing, knees soft, bar against your thighs.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Stop when your hamstrings are stretched and your back is still flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.
barbell_deadlift_stiff_leg: Keep your knees almost straight for the whole rep.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar close to your legs.
Go only as low as you can with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
barbell_good_morning: Rest the bar on your upper back as for a squat.
Bend your knees slightly and keep them there.
Push your hips back and lower your chest with a flat back.
Start light and stop before your back starts to round.
barbell_hip_thrust: Rest your upper back on a bench, with a padded bar across your hips.
Feet flat and about hip-width, shins vertical at the top.
Drive through your heels until your hips line up with your knees.
Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down; don't arch to finish.
barbell_glute_bridge: Lie on the floor, knees bent, bar across your hips.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second.
Lower your hips to the floor under control.
barbell_calf_raise_standing: Bar on your upper back, balls of your feet on a plate or step.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes and pause.
Keep your knees straight but not hard-locked.
barbell_curl: Stand tall, grip shoulder-width, palms up.
Keep your elbows at your sides as you lift.
Lift without swinging your torso or hips.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
barbell_curl_reverse: Grip the bar overhand, about shoulder-width.
Keep your wrists straight, in line with your forearms.
Lift with your elbows fixed at your sides.
Lower under control; this grip takes a lighter load.
barbell_curl_preacher: Set the seat so your armpits rest on the top edge of the pad.
Keep the backs of your upper arms on the pad.
Lift without raising your elbows off the pad.
Lower slowly to almost straight; don't drop into the bottom.
barbell_curl_drag: Grip shoulder-width, palms up, bar against your thighs.
Pull your elbows back as you lift.
Drag the bar up along your body to your lower chest.
Lower it the same way, keeping the bar against you.
ez_bar_curl: Grip the angled parts of the bar, palms up.
Keep your elbows at your sides for the whole rep.
ez_bar_curl_preacher: Armpits on the top edge of the pad, upper arms flat on it.
Grip the inner angles of the bar.
Lift until your forearms are nearly vertical.
Lower under control without bouncing at the bottom.
ez_bar_triceps_lying: Lie on a bench and hold the bar over your shoulders on the angled grips.
Keep your upper arms still, tilted slightly back toward your head.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar to your forehead or just behind it.
Straighten your elbows to return without flaring them out.
barbell_triceps_lying: Lie on a bench with a narrow grip, bar over your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms fixed; only your elbows bend.
Lower the bar slowly toward your forehead.
Press back up by straightening your elbows, keeping them in.
barbell_wrist_curl: Sit with your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms up.
Let your wrists bend back so the bar rolls toward your fingers.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Keep your forearms flat; only your wrists move.
barbell_wrist_curl_reverse: Rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down.
Lower the bar by letting your wrists bend down.
Lift the backs of your hands as high as you can.
Use a light load and move slowly.
barbell_rollout: Kneel with your hands on the bar, under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Roll forward only as far as you can without your lower back sagging.
Pull back with your abs, not by bending at the hips first.
dumbbell_bench_flat: Kick the dumbbells up from your thighs as you lie back.
Pull your shoulder blades together and down on the bench.
Lower until the dumbbells are beside your chest, elbows about 45°.
Press up and slightly in, without clanking them at the top.
dumbbell_bench_one_arm: Lie on a flat bench with one dumbbell; hold the bench with your free hand.
Brace your abs so your body doesn't roll toward the weight.
Lower beside your chest, elbow about 45° from your body.
Press up and finish all reps before switching sides.
dumbbell_bench_incline: Set the bench to 30–45° and plant your feet.
Keep your shoulder blades back against the bench.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest.
dumbbell_bench_decline: Secure your legs under the pads before lying back.
Hold the dumbbells over your lower chest.
Lower them to the sides of your lower chest with control.
After the set, sit up with the dumbbells held close to your chest.
dumbbell_bench_neutral: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows close to your body as you lower.
Lower until the dumbbells reach the sides of your chest.
Press straight up, palms still facing in.
dumbbell_floor_press: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat.
Lower until your upper arms rest on the floor.
Pause briefly with the dumbbells over your elbows.
Press up without bouncing off the floor.
dumbbell_floor_press_one_arm: Lie on the floor, knees bent, one dumbbell over your shoulder.
Brace your abs to stop your body from rolling.
Lower until your upper arm touches the floor.
Press up, and finish one side before switching.
dumbbell_fly_flat: Start with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight, fixed bend in your elbows.
Open your arms wide until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together along the same arc.
dumbbell_fly_incline: Set the bench to about 30° and hold the dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout.
Lower in a wide arc until your arms are about level with the bench.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back up.
dumbbell_pullover: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Bring it back over your chest without bending your elbows more.
dumbbell_row_one_arm: Put one knee and one hand on a bench, back flat and level.
Let the dumbbell hang straight below your shoulder.
Pull it toward your hip, elbow close to your body.
Lower to a full stretch without twisting your torso.
dumbbell_row_chest_supported: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, feet on the floor.
Let the dumbbells hang with your arms straight.
Row them up, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Keep your chest on the pad; don't lift it to finish.
dumbbell_row_bent_over: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, dumbbells below your shoulders.
Keep your knees soft and your neck in line with your back.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips.
Lower under control, holding the same torso angle.
dumbbell_row_renegade: Start in a high plank on the dumbbells, feet wider than your hips.
Brace your abs and glutes to keep your hips square.
Row one dumbbell to your hip without rotating your body.
Set it down quietly and alternate sides.
dumbbell_shrug: Stand tall with the dumbbells at your sides and your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower all the way down.
Keep your elbows straight and don't roll your shoulders.
dumbbell_press_seated: Sit on an upright bench with your back against the pad.
Start with the dumbbells at shoulder height, forearms vertical.
Press up until your arms are straight over your shoulders.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.
dumbbell_press_standing: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press straight up without leaning back.
Lower under control to your shoulders.
dumbbell_press_arnold: Start with the dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Rotate your palms outward as you press up.
Finish overhead with your palms facing forward.
Reverse the rotation on the way down.
dumbbell_raise_lateral: Stand tall with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.
dumbbell_raise_lateral_seated: Sit on the end of a bench with your back tall.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides with a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.
dumbbell_raise_front: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise them forward with a slight bend in your elbows.
dumbbell_fly_reverse: Hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let the dumbbells hang with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides, squeezing your upper back.
Lower slowly, keeping your back flat.
dumbbell_fly_reverse_incline: Lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Let the dumbbells hang with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they line up with your body.
Keep your chest on the pad and lower slowly.
dumbbell_upright_row: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Lift them close to your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows reach about shoulder height.
dumbbell_squat_goblet: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest.
Feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Squat down between your knees, elbows inside them.
Keep your chest up and drive up through your whole foot.
dumbbell_squat_front: Rest the dumbbells on the front of your shoulders.
Keep your elbows up and your torso upright.
Squat down with your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your whole foot.
dumbbell_squat_bulgarian: Rest the top of your back foot on a bench behind you.
Hold the dumbbells at your sides with your arms straight.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot and keep that heel down.
dumbbell_split_squat: Take a long stance with the dumbbells at your sides.
Drop your back knee straight down toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel planted.
dumbbell_lunge_reverse: Stand tall with the dumbbells at your sides.
Step back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front heel to return.
dumbbell_lunge_forward: Stand tall with the dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent to about 90°.
Keep your front knee in line with your foot.
Push off your front foot to step back to the start.
dumbbell_lunge_walking: Step forward into a long stride, dumbbells at your sides.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive up and bring your back leg through into the next step.
Keep your torso upright the whole way.
dumbbell_lunge_lateral: Start with your feet together and the dumbbells at your sides.
Take a wide step to the side and sit your hips back over that foot.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet pointing forward.
Push off the bent leg to return to the start.
dumbbell_step_up: Pick a box around knee height; go higher only if your form holds.
Place your whole foot on the box.
Drive up through that foot without pushing off your back leg.
Step down under control; finish all reps on that side.
dumbbell_deadlift_romanian: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees soft.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop at a strong hamstring stretch, back still flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.
dumbbell_deadlift_romanian_one_leg: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward as your free leg rises behind you.
Keep your hips square to the floor; don't let them open.
Return by driving the standing hip forward.
dumbbell_deadlift_sumo: Take a wide stance, toes out, one dumbbell hanging between your legs.
Hold it by one end with both hands, arms straight.
Sit your hips down and back with your knees pushed out.
Stand up by driving through your heels, chest up.
dumbbell_hip_thrust: Rest your upper back on a bench with the dumbbell on your hips.
Hold the dumbbell in place with both hands.
Drive through your heels until your hips line up with your knees.
Keep your chin tucked and squeeze your glutes at the top.
dumbbell_calf_raise_standing: Stand on a step on the balls of your feet, dumbbells at your sides.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise as high as you can and pause at the top.
dumbbell_calf_raise_one_leg: Stand on one foot on a step, dumbbell in the same-side hand.
Hold a support with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel for a full stretch, then rise as high as you can.
dumbbell_calf_raise_seated: Sit with the balls of your feet on a plate or step.
Rest the dumbbells on your knees and hold them in place.
Lower your heels, then lift them as high as you can.
Pause at the top of each rep.
dumbbell_curl_standing: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
dumbbell_curl_hammer: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing your body.
Keep your palms facing in for the whole rep.
Lift with your elbows fixed at your sides.
dumbbell_curl_incline: Sit back on a bench set to about 45–60°.
Let your arms hang straight down, behind the line of your body.
Lift without bringing your elbows forward.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.
dumbbell_curl_concentration: Sit and brace the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Start with the arm straight below your shoulder.
Lift toward your shoulder without moving your upper arm.
Lower slowly, and finish one side before switching.
dumbbell_curl_preacher: Rest your upper arm flat on the preacher pad.
Start with your elbow nearly straight.
Lift until your forearm is close to vertical.
Lower slowly without lifting your elbow off the pad.
dumbbell_curl_spider: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging straight.
Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
Lift the dumbbells and squeeze at the top.
dumbbell_curl_reverse: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing back.
Keep your wrists straight, in line with your forearms.
Lift with your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly, with a lighter load than a regular curl.
dumbbell_curl_zottman: Lift with your palms facing up.
At the top, turn your palms to face down.
Lower slowly with your palms down.
Turn your palms back up at the bottom.
dumbbell_triceps_overhead_two_hands: Hold one dumbbell overhead, both hands cupping the top end.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Brace your abs and straighten your elbows without arching your back.
dumbbell_triceps_overhead_one_arm: Hold the dumbbell overhead, arm straight, upper arm by your ear.
Lower it behind your head by bending only your elbow.
Keep your elbow pointing up, not out to the side.
Straighten your arm fully, and finish one side before switching.
dumbbell_triceps_lying: Lie on a bench, dumbbells over your shoulders, palms facing in.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
dumbbell_triceps_kickback: Hinge forward with a flat back and one hand on a bench.
Hold your upper arm parallel to the floor, close to your side.
Straighten your elbow until your arm is fully extended.
Lower your forearm under control; your upper arm stays still.
dumbbell_wrist_curl: Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, palm up.
Let your wrist bend back so the dumbbell lowers.
Curl your wrist up as high as you can.
Keep your forearm flat; only your wrist moves.
dumbbell_wrist_curl_reverse: Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, palm down.
Let your wrist bend down with the dumbbell.
Lift the back of your hand as high as you can.
Use a light load and move slowly.
dumbbell_side_bend: Stand tall with one dumbbell at your side.
Bend sideways toward the dumbbell, sliding it down your leg.
Don't lean forward or back as you bend.
Use the opposite side to pull back upright, then switch.
dumbbell_crunch: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a dumbbell on your chest.
Bring your ribs toward your hips, lifting your shoulder blades.
Keep your chin slightly tucked and your neck relaxed.
Lower slowly without letting the weight pull you down.
kettlebell_squat_goblet: Hold the kettlebell by the sides of the handle, against your chest, elbows down.
Feet a bit wider than your shoulders, toes turned slightly out.
Squat down between your knees, keeping them in line with your toes.
Keep your chest up and drive up through your whole foot.
kettlebell_squat_front_double: Clean both kettlebells to the rack, resting on your forearms at chest height.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Squat down with your chest up; don't let the weight pull you forward.
Brace before each rep and drive up through your whole foot.
kettlebell_lunge_reverse_racked: Hold one kettlebell in the rack position, elbow tucked to your ribs.
Step back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso tall; don't lean toward or away from the weight.
Push through your front foot to return; finish all reps on that side.
kettlebell_deadlift: Set the kettlebell between your feet, in line with the middle of your foot.
Push your hips back and grip the handle with a flat back.
Pull your shoulders down and brace your abs before you lift.
Stand up by driving your hips forward; squeeze your glutes at the top.
kettlebell_deadlift_romanian: Stand tall holding the kettlebell by the handle, arms long.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, the kettlebell close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand; don't lean back at the top.
kettlebell_deadlift_one_leg: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, kettlebell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward as your free leg rises behind you.
Keep your hips level; don't let them open.
Keep the kettlebell close to your standing leg, then drive that hip forward to return.
kettlebell_swing_two_hand: Start with the kettlebell a little in front of you and hike it back between your legs.
It's a hinge, not a squat: hips go back, shins stay nearly vertical.
Snap your hips forward and let the kettlebell float to chest height.
Stand tall at the top, glutes and abs tight; don't lean back.
kettlebell_swing_one_hand: Grip the handle with one hand and keep that shoulder down.
Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, thumb pointing back.
Snap your hips forward with your shoulders square; don't twist.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch hands.
kettlebell_clean: Hike the kettlebell back, then drive your hips forward.
Keep your elbow close so the kettlebell rises near your body, not in a wide arc.
Turn your hand around the handle so it lands softly on your forearm.
Finish in the rack: wrist neutral, elbow by your ribs, glutes tight.
kettlebell_snatch: Hike the kettlebell back, then drive your hips forward hard.
Pull it up close to your body, leading with your elbow.
As it passes your head, punch your hand through so it doesn't slam your forearm.
Lock out overhead, biceps by your ear, then let it drop into the next swing.
kettlebell_clean_press: Clean the kettlebell to the rack, wrist neutral and elbow by your ribs.
Pause in the rack and tighten your glutes and abs before pressing.
Press up until your arm is locked, biceps by your ear.
Lower back to the rack with control before the next clean.
kettlebell_press: Start in the rack: wrist neutral, elbow under the kettlebell, forearm vertical.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so you don't lean back.
Press up and slightly out, finishing with your biceps by your ear.
No leg drive; lower back to the rack under control.
kettlebell_push_press: Start in the rack with your elbow tucked and your abs braced.
Make a short, quick dip at the knees, torso upright.
Drive up with your legs and press the kettlebell overhead in one move.
Lock out with your biceps by your ear, then lower to the rack, bending your knees.
kettlebell_floor_press: Lie on your side, take the kettlebell with both hands, then roll onto your back.
Knees bent, upper arm about 45° from your body, wrist neutral.
Press up until your arm is locked over your shoulder.
Lower until your upper arm touches the floor, pause, then press again.
kettlebell_row: Brace one hand on a bench and hinge until your back is flat and nearly level.
Let the kettlebell hang below your shoulder.
Row it toward your hip, elbow close to your body.
Lower to a full stretch without twisting your torso.
kettlebell_gorilla_row: Stand wide with two kettlebells between your feet, hinged with a flat back.
Hold both handles and press one kettlebell into the floor as you row the other.
Row toward your hip without rotating your torso.
Set it down with control before switching sides.
kettlebell_high_pull: Hike the kettlebell back between your legs with one hand.
Snap your hips forward and let it float up.
Pull your elbow up and back, finishing with your hand near chest height.
Push the kettlebell back out and let it drop into the next swing.
kettlebell_halo: Hold the kettlebell upside down by the sides of the handle, at chest height.
Circle it around your head, keeping it close to your neck.
Keep your ribs down and your hips still; only your arms move.
Switch direction every rep or every set.
kettlebell_turkish_get_up: Lying down with the kettlebell pressed up, keep your eyes on it the whole time.
Keep the loaded arm vertical and locked from start to finish.
One step at a time: elbow, hand, hips up, sweep the leg through to a kneel, then stand.
Reverse the steps to come down; start light until each one feels steady.
kettlebell_windmill: Press the kettlebell overhead and turn your feet about 45° away from it.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and the loaded arm vertical.
Push your hip out toward the loaded side and slide your free hand down the other leg.
Go only as low as you can with a long spine, then stand back up.
kettlebell_curl: Hold the kettlebell by the sides of the handle, arms extended, elbows at your sides.
Curl it up to chest height without moving your elbows forward.
Keep your torso still; don't swing with your hips.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
kettlebell_triceps_overhead: Hold the kettlebell overhead by the sides of the handle, arms extended.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, elbows pointing up.
Keep your elbows close to your head as you straighten your arms.
Brace your abs so your lower back doesn't arch.
cable_chest_fly_mid: Set both pulleys at about shoulder height and stand with one foot forward.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows that stays the same all set.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Open back slowly to a stretch without your shoulders rolling forward.
cable_chest_fly_high_low: Set the pulleys high; stand with one foot forward and lean slightly in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows that doesn't change.
Sweep your hands down and together in front of your hips.
Return slowly along the same arc, keeping your chest up.
cable_chest_fly_low_high: Set the pulleys at the bottom and stand in the middle, one foot slightly forward.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows that doesn't change.
Sweep your hands up until they meet in front of your upper chest.
Keep your shoulders down, without shrugging, and lower slowly.
cable_chest_fly_one_arm: Stand side-on to a pulley at about shoulder height, handle in your near hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow that doesn't change.
Sweep your hand across to the middle of your chest without turning your torso.
Return slowly to a stretch; finish all reps on that side.
cable_chest_fly_flat_bench: Place a flat bench between two low pulleys and lie with the handles over your chest.
Set your shoulder blades back and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms in a wide arc until your hands are about level with your chest.
Bring the handles back together over your chest, squeezing your pecs.
cable_chest_fly_incline_bench: Set an incline bench at 30–45° between two low pulleys.
Start with the handles over your upper chest, elbows slightly bent.
Lower in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Bring your hands back together without your shoulders leaving the bench.
cable_chest_press: Set the pulleys at chest height and stand with one foot forward.
Start with the handles by your chest, elbows about 45° from your body.
Press forward until your arms are fully extended, without leaning in.
Brace your abs so the cables don't pull you back.
cable_shoulder_press: Sit on a bench between two low pulleys, back against the pad.
Start with the handles at shoulder height, forearms vertical.
Press up until your arms are extended over your shoulders.
Lower to shoulder height with control, without arching your lower back.
cable_row_close_neutral: Sit with your feet on the platform and your knees slightly bent.
Chest up and torso still; don't rock back to move the weight.
Pull the handle to your upper stomach, elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then extend your arms slowly.
cable_row_wide_overhand: Use a long bar with a wide overhand grip.
Sit tall, knees slightly bent, torso still.
Pull the bar to your lower chest, elbows out to the sides.
Squeeze your upper back, then extend your arms with control.
cable_row_underhand: Use a straight bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width.
Sit tall with your knees slightly bent.
Pull to your belly button, elbows close to your sides.
Extend your arms slowly without leaning forward.
cable_row_one_arm: Sit facing the pulley with one handle; rest your other hand on your thigh.
Sit tall and let your arm reach forward without rounding your back.
Pull the handle to your side, elbow close to your body.
Don't twist to finish the pull; complete all reps on that side.
cable_lat_pulldown_wide: Lock your thighs under the pad and grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Let it rise with control until your arms are extended.
cable_lat_pulldown_underhand: Grip the bar underhand at about shoulder width.
Thighs under the pad, chest up, slight lean back.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows close to your body.
Control the bar on the way up until your arms are extended.
cable_lat_pulldown_neutral: Attach a close-grip V-handle and sit with your thighs under the pad.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Return slowly until your arms are extended.
cable_lat_pulldown_one_arm: Use a single handle on the high pulley, seated or kneeling.
Start with your arm extended and a full stretch along your side.
Pull your elbow down toward your hip, keeping your torso still.
Return slowly; finish all reps on that side.
cable_straight_arm_pulldown_bar: Face a high pulley with a straight bar and hinge forward slightly at the hips.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows that doesn't change.
Sweep the bar down in an arc until it reaches your thighs.
Return slowly to about head height without arching your lower back.
cable_straight_arm_pulldown_rope: Attach a rope to the high pulley and hinge forward slightly at the hips.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows that doesn't change.
Pull the rope down in an arc to your thighs, spreading the ends at the bottom.
Return slowly until your arms are about level with your head.
cable_face_pull: Set the rope at about head height; hold the ends with your thumbs toward you.
Step back until there's tension and stand tall.
Pull toward your face, splitting the rope and driving your elbows high and back.
Finish with your hands beside your ears, then return slowly.
cable_reverse_fly: Set the pulleys at shoulder height and hold the cables crossed, each hand on the far one.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows that doesn't change.
Pull your arms out wide until they line up with your shoulders.
Don't shrug or arch your back; return slowly to the crossed position.
cable_lateral_raise: Stand side-on to a low pulley and take the handle in your far hand.
Hold the machine with your free hand for balance.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, leading with your elbow.
Lower slowly without shrugging; finish all reps on that side.
cable_front_raise: Stand facing away from a low pulley, handle in one hand by your side.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and don't lean back.
Raise your arm in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower slowly; finish all reps on that side.
cable_upright_row: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and grip it overhand, about shoulder-width.
Lift the bar close to your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop near lower-chest height, elbows no higher than your shoulders.
Lower with control and keep your torso still.
cable_external_rotation: Set the pulley at elbow height, stand side-on and take the handle in your far hand.
Bend your elbow to 90° and keep it against your side.
Rotate your forearm out, away from your body, without moving your elbow.
Use a light load and return slowly; finish all reps on that side.
cable_curl_straight_bar: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and grip it underhand, shoulder-width.
Stand close to the pulley with your elbows at your sides.
Curl up without swinging or moving your elbows forward.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
cable_curl_rope: Attach a rope to the low pulley and hold the ends, palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your wrists firm.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Lower slowly until your arms are extended.
cable_curl_one_arm: Hold a single handle from the low pulley, palm up.
Keep your elbow against your side and stand tall.
Curl all the way up and squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly; finish all reps on that side.
cable_curl_behind_body: Face away from a low pulley, handle in one hand, and step forward.
Let the cable pull your arm slightly behind your body.
Curl up keeping your elbow back; don't let it drift forward.
Lower slowly to a full stretch; finish all reps on that side.
cable_curl_high: Stand between two high pulleys, arms out to the sides at shoulder height, palms up.
Only your forearms move; your upper arms stay level with your shoulders.
Curl the handles toward your ears and squeeze.
Extend your elbows slowly back to the start.
cable_curl_preacher: Set a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a short bar.
Keep the backs of your upper arms on the pad, armpits at its top edge.
Curl up without lifting your elbows off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost fully extended.
cable_triceps_pushdown_rope: Attach a rope to the high pulley and hold the ends, palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows against your sides and lean forward slightly.
Push down until your arms are extended, spreading the ends at the bottom.
Let your forearms rise to about parallel with the floor, elbows still.
cable_triceps_pushdown_bar: Grip the straight bar overhand, about shoulder-width.
Keep your elbows against your sides and still all set.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Don't lean your weight over the bar; let it rise slowly.
cable_triceps_pushdown_reverse: Grip the bar underhand, hands about shoulder-width.
Keep your elbows against your sides and your wrists firm.
Push down until your arms are fully extended.
Use less load than with the overhand grip and return slowly.
cable_triceps_overhead_rope: Face away from the pulley, rope behind your head, one foot forward.
Lean forward slightly, elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Straighten your elbows, spreading the rope ends at the finish.
Return slowly to a deep stretch without your elbows flaring out.
cable_triceps_pushdown_one_arm: Hold a single handle from the high pulley, elbow against your side.
Push down until your arm is fully extended.
Keep your shoulder down and your torso still.
Return slowly; finish all reps on that side.
cable_triceps_cross_body: Take the handle of a high pulley in your far hand, the cable crossing in front of you.
Keep your upper arm still; only your forearm moves.
Extend your arm out to the side until your elbow is straight.
Return slowly across your body; finish all reps on that side.
cable_pull_through: Face away from a low pulley with the rope between your legs.
Walk forward until there's tension, feet a bit wider than your hips.
Push your hips back with a flat back, letting the rope pass between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand and squeeze your glutes; your arms only hold.
cable_glute_kickback: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and face the machine.
Hold the frame, lean forward slightly, standing knee soft.
Kick the leg back by squeezing your glute, not by arching your lower back.
Return slowly; finish all reps on that side.
cable_hip_abduction: Stand side-on to a low pulley with the strap on your far ankle.
Hold the machine and stand tall on your other leg.
Lift the leg out to the side, toes forward, without leaning your torso.
Return slowly; finish all reps on that side.
cable_hip_adduction: Stand side-on to a low pulley with the strap on your near ankle.
Step away until the cable pulls that leg out to the side.
Bring the leg in until it crosses in front of your standing leg, torso still.
Return slowly; finish all reps on that side.
cable_leg_curl: Strap the cuff to one ankle and face a low pulley.
Hold the frame, knees side by side, standing leg slightly bent.
Curl your heel toward your glutes without moving your thigh.
Lower slowly; finish all reps on that side.
cable_crunch_kneeling: Kneel facing a high pulley and hold the rope beside your head.
Keep your hips still; don't sit back onto your heels.
Curl your torso down, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly until you feel your abs stretch.
cable_crunch_standing: Stand with your back to a high pulley, rope ends beside your head.
Soften your knees and keep your hips still.
Curl your torso down, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Don't bend at the hips; return slowly until you stand tall.
cable_woodchop_high_low: Set the pulley high and stand side-on, feet wider than your shoulders.
Grip the handle with both hands, arms long.
Pull it diagonally across your body toward the opposite knee, turning your torso.
Let the foot nearest the pulley pivot; return slowly and finish all reps on that side.
cable_woodchop_low_high: Set the pulley low and stand side-on, feet wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees slightly and hold the handle with both hands by your near knee.
Pull it diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder, turning your torso.
Let the foot nearest the pulley pivot; return slowly and finish all reps on that side.
cable_pallof_press: Stand side-on to a pulley at chest height, handle held at your chest.
Step away until there's tension, feet hip-width, knees soft.
Press the handle straight out in front and hold it without rotating.
Bring it back to your chest slowly; finish all reps on that side.
bodyweight_push_up: Hands a bit wider than your shoulders, body in one line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and abs so your hips don't sag.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, elbows about 45° from your body.
Push the floor away until your arms are extended.
bodyweight_push_up_incline: Put your hands on a bench or box, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in one line from head to heels.
Lower your chest to the edge, elbows about 45° from your body.
The higher the support, the easier; use a lower one as you get stronger.
bodyweight_push_up_decline: Feet on a bench or box, hands on the floor a bit wider than your shoulders.
Brace your abs and glutes so your hips don't sag or pike up.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows about 45° from your body.
Keep your neck in line with your body and push back up.
bodyweight_push_up_wide: Place your hands clearly wider than your shoulders.
Turn your fingers slightly out and keep your body in one line.
Lower your chest between your hands with control.
Push up without letting your hips sag.
bodyweight_push_up_diamond: Put your hands together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your elbows close to your body as you lower.
Lower until your chest nearly touches your hands.
Keep your body in one line and press back up.
bodyweight_push_up_archer: Set your hands very wide, fingers turned out.
Lower toward one hand, bending that elbow while the other arm stays extended.
Keep your hips level and your body in one line.
Push back to the center, then alternate sides or finish one side first.
bodyweight_push_up_pike: Start with your hips high so your body makes an upside-down V.
Hands about shoulder-width, head between your arms.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor, just ahead of your hands.
Keep your hips high and press back up.
bodyweight_push_up_handstand: Kick up to a handstand against the wall, hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Brace your abs and glutes so your back doesn't arch.
Lower slowly until your head lightly touches the floor or a mat.
Press up until your arms lock; build up with pike push-ups first.
bodyweight_dip_chest: Support yourself on the bars with your arms locked.
Lean your torso forward and let your elbows flare slightly.
Lower until your shoulders are a little below your elbows, or as far as is comfortable.
Press back up without shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.
bodyweight_dip_triceps: Support yourself on the bars, arms locked and shoulders down.
Keep your torso upright and your elbows close to your body.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press up until your elbows are fully extended.
bodyweight_bench_dip: Put your hands on the edge of a bench behind you, fingers forward.
Keep your hips close to the bench; bending your knees makes it easier.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, no deeper.
Press up through your palms until your arms are extended.
bodyweight_pull_up: Grip the bar overhand, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Start from a dead hang and pull your shoulders down first.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, without kicking or swinging.
Lower all the way down with control.
bodyweight_pull_up_wide: Grip the bar overhand, clearly wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulders down and keep your chest up.
Drive your elbows down and out to bring your chest toward the bar.
Lower to full extension with control, without swinging.
bodyweight_pull_up_neutral: Use the parallel handles, palms facing each other.
Start from a dead hang with your shoulders pulled down.
Pull until your chin clears the handles, elbows close to your body.
Lower all the way down with control.
bodyweight_chin_up: Grip the bar underhand at about shoulder width.
Start from a dead hang and brace your abs.
Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
Lower to full extension without dropping.
bodyweight_row_inverted: Hang under a bar at about waist height, overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in one line from shoulders to heels.
Pull your chest to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower until your arms are extended; bend your knees to make it easier.
bodyweight_row_inverted_underhand: Hang under a bar at about waist height with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Brace your glutes and abs so your hips stay in line.
Pull the bar to your lower chest, elbows close to your body.
Lower with control until your arms are extended.
bodyweight_squat: Feet about shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out.
Reach your arms forward for balance and sit down between your knees.
Keep your heels down and your knees in line with your toes.
Go as deep as you can with a flat back, then stand up.
bodyweight_split_squat: Stand in a long split stance with your back heel up.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel down.
Push through your front foot; finish all reps before switching.
bodyweight_bulgarian_split_squat: Rest the top of your back foot on a bench behind you.
Set your front foot far enough out that its heel stays down at the bottom.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot; finish all reps before switching.
bodyweight_lunge_reverse: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your weight on your front foot and your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return; alternate legs or finish one side.
bodyweight_lunge_forward: Take a long step forward, landing with your whole foot.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee in line with your toes and your torso upright.
Push off your front foot to step back to the start.
bodyweight_lunge_lateral: Start with your feet together and your arms in front for balance.
Take a wide step to the side and sit your hips back over that foot.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet pointing forward.
Push off the bent leg to return to the start.
bodyweight_step_up: Pick a box around knee height; go higher only if your form holds.
Place your whole foot on the box.
Drive up through that foot without pushing off your back leg.
Step down under control; finish all reps on that side.
bodyweight_pistol_squat: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended in front of you.
Reach your arms forward to counterbalance as you sit down.
Keep your standing heel down and your knee in line with your toes.
Hold a support or squat to a box until you can do the full range.
bodyweight_squat_jump: Squat down partway, swinging your arms back.
Jump explosively, driving your arms up.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, then lower your heels and bend your knees.
Keep your knees in line with your toes when you land.
bodyweight_reverse_nordic: Kneel on a pad, knees hip-width, body in one line from knees to head.
Squeeze your glutes and abs to hold that line.
Lean back slowly with your hips extended; don't sit toward your heels.
Go only as far as you can control, then pull back up with your thighs.
bodyweight_glute_bridge: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat about hip-width.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Stop when your shoulders, hips and knees line up; don't arch your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second, then lower slowly.
bodyweight_glute_bridge_one_leg: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Press through the heel of the planted foot to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level; don't let one side drop.
Lower slowly; finish all reps before switching legs.
bodyweight_hip_thrust: Rest your upper back on a bench, knees bent and feet flat.
Feet about hip-width, shins vertical at the top.
Drive through your heels until your hips line up with your knees.
Tuck your chin, keep your ribs down and squeeze your glutes at the top.
bodyweight_nordic_curl: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held under something solid.
Keep one line from knees to head, hips extended.
Lower forward as slowly as you can, resisting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands and push off lightly to come back up.
bodyweight_hamstring_walkout: Start in a glute bridge with your heels on the floor.
Walk your heels out in small steps, keeping your hips up.
Go until your legs are nearly extended or your hips start to drop.
Walk your heels back to the start, hips still high.
bodyweight_calf_raise: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step, heels hanging off.
Hold a support lightly for balance.
Lower your heels for a full stretch, then rise as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top; don't bounce at the bottom.
bodyweight_calf_raise_one_leg: Stand on one foot on a step, heel hanging off.
Hold a support with one hand for balance.
Lower your heel for a full stretch, then rise as high as you can.
bodyweight_crunch: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands by your head or across your chest.
Bring your ribs toward your hips, lifting your shoulder blades.
Don't pull on your head; keep your neck relaxed.
Lower slowly back to the start.
bodyweight_reverse_crunch: Lie on your back, hands by your sides, knees bent and lifted.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Use your abs, not momentum from swinging your legs.
Lower your hips slowly until they touch the floor.
bodyweight_sit_up: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat or held down.
Curl up with your chin slightly tucked; don't pull on your head.
Come up until your torso is upright.
Lower slowly instead of dropping back.
bodyweight_bicycle_crunch: Lie on your back, hands by your head, shoulder blades off the floor.
Bring one knee in as you turn the opposite shoulder toward it.
Extend the other leg low without touching the floor.
Move slowly and rotate from your torso, without pulling your neck.
bodyweight_hanging_knee_raise: Hang from a bar with your shoulders pulled down.
Raise your knees toward your chest and curl your hips up at the top.
Avoid swinging; pause briefly between reps if needed.
Lower your legs slowly, under control.
bodyweight_hanging_leg_raise: Hang from a bar, shoulders pulled down, legs together.
Raise your legs, knees extended, to hip height or higher.
Curl your hips up at the top so your abs work, not just your hip flexors.
Lower slowly and stop the swing before the next rep.
bodyweight_captains_chair_knee_raise: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back into the backrest.
Let your legs hang and keep your shoulders down.
Raise your knees toward your chest and curl your hips up at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging your legs.
bodyweight_lying_leg_raise: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor before each rep.
Raise your legs, knees extended, until they point up.
Lower slowly, only as far as your lower back stays on the floor.
bodyweight_dead_bug: Lie on your back, arms up and knees bent at 90° over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor and keep it there.
Slowly extend one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Breathe out as you reach, come back, then switch sides.
bodyweight_bird_dog: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both line up with your torso.
Keep your hips level; don't let your lower back arch or twist.
Pause, return slowly, then switch sides.
bodyweight_back_extension: Set the pad at the top of your thighs, ankles locked in, so your hips can bend.
Cross your arms on your chest or hold your hands by your head.
Lower your torso with a flat back, under control.
Rise until your body lines up with your legs; don't arch past that.
bodyweight_glute_ham_raise: Set the footplate so your knees sit just behind the pad.
Start with your body level, hips extended, in one line from knees to head.
Press your toes into the plate and curl your body up with your hamstrings.
Keep your hips extended and lower slowly back to level.
smith_bench_flat: Place the bench so the bar comes down on your lower chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down, feet planted.
Lower with control, elbows about 45° from your body, then press up.
Set the safety stops just below where the bar touches your chest.
smith_bench_incline: Set the bench to 30–45°, placed so the bar comes down on your upper chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back and your hips on the bench.
Lower with control to your upper chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Set the safety stops just below where the bar touches your chest.
smith_bench_decline: Lock your legs under the pads and line the bar up with your lower chest.
Keep your shoulder blades back and down on the bench.
Lower the bar with control to your lower chest, then press up.
Set the safety stops just below where the bar touches your chest.
smith_bench_close_grip: Grip about shoulder-width, a little narrower than your usual bench.
Place the bench so the bar comes down on your lower chest.
Keep your elbows close to your sides as you lower.
Press by straightening your elbows, wrists stacked over them.
smith_shoulder_press: Set an upright bench so the bar passes just in front of your face.
Start with the bar at about chin height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Keep your back against the pad and your abs braced; don't arch.
Press up until your arms are extended, then lower with control.
smith_upright_row: Stand close to the bar and grip it overhand, about shoulder-width.
Lift the bar close to your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop near lower-chest height, elbows no higher than your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are extended.
smith_shrug: Unhook the bar with your arms extended, in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears without rolling them.
Keep your arms extended; don't bend your elbows to pull.
Pause at the top, then lower all the way down.
smith_bent_over_row: Stand close to the bar and grip overhand, a little wider than your shoulders.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, torso at about 45° or closer to parallel.
Pull the bar to your upper stomach, leading with your elbows.
Lower under control without standing up between reps.
smith_squat: Rest the bar on top of your traps, feet slightly in front of the bar.
Set the safety stops just below the lowest point of your squat.
Brace your abs and sit down with your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your whole foot without locking your knees hard at the top.
smith_front_squat: Rest the bar on your front shoulders, close to your throat.
Keep your elbows high so the bar stays on your shoulders.
Feet under the bar or slightly in front, torso upright.
Squat down with control and drive up through your whole foot.
smith_split_squat: Bar on your upper back; take a long stance with your front foot ahead of the bar.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel planted.
Push through your front foot; finish all reps before switching.
smith_lunge_reverse: Stand under the bar with it on your upper back, feet hip-width.
Step one foot back and lower that knee toward the floor.
Keep your weight on your front foot and your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to step back in; finish all reps on that side.
smith_deadlift_romanian: Start standing with the bar against your thighs, knees soft.
Push your hips back and lower the bar close to your legs.
Stop when your hamstrings are stretched and your back is still flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand up; don't lean back at the top.
smith_hip_thrust: Rest your upper back on a bench, the bar over your hips on a pad.
Feet flat and about hip-width, shins vertical at the top.
Drive through your heels until your shoulders, hips and knees line up.
Keep your ribs down and squeeze your glutes; don't arch to finish.
smith_calf_raise: Bar on your upper back, balls of your feet on a plate or step.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes and pause.
Keep your knees straight but not hard-locked.
selectorized_chest_press: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest.
Back and head against the pad, shoulder blades pulled back.
Press forward until your arms are extended, without locking your elbows hard.
Return slowly; don't let the weight stack touch down between reps.
selectorized_chest_press_incline: Set the seat so the handles start at your upper chest.
Keep your back on the pad and your shoulders down, not shrugged.
Press up and forward until your arms are extended.
Return slowly to a stretch without the weight stack touching down.
selectorized_pec_fly: Set the seat so the handles are at about shoulder height.
Keep a slight, fixed bend in your elbows.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest, squeezing your pecs.
Open slowly until your arms are about in line with your body, shoulders back.
selectorized_shoulder_press: Set the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height.
Keep your back against the pad and your abs braced.
Press up until your arms are extended, without shrugging.
Lower slowly to shoulder height before the next rep.
selectorized_lateral_raise: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot.
Rest the outside of your upper arms against the pads, elbows bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly, without shrugging or leaning your torso.
selectorized_reverse_fly: Sit facing the pad with your chest against it.
Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
With elbows slightly bent, pull your arms out wide until they line up with your shoulders.
Don't shrug; return slowly without the weight stack touching down.
selectorized_lat_pulldown: Set the thigh pad so your legs are locked in snugly.
Start with your arms extended and your chest up.
Pull down, driving your elbows toward your sides, until your hands reach shoulder height.
Let the handles rise with control until your arms are extended.
selectorized_seated_row: Set the seat so the handles are at about mid-chest height.
Keep your chest against the pad for the whole set.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are extended.
selectorized_high_row: Set the seat so you reach the handles with your arms fully extended.
Sit tall with your chest up and your feet flat.
Pull down and back until your hands are near your chest, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end, then return slowly.
selectorized_pullover: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot.
Rest your elbows on the pads and keep your grip loose.
Sweep your arms down in an arc until the bar reaches your stomach.
Return slowly overhead to a stretch, without arching your lower back.
selectorized_assisted_pull_up: The more weight you select, the more help you get.
Kneel or stand on the platform and grip overhand, a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulders down first, then pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way down with control, without swinging.
selectorized_assisted_dip: The more weight you select, the more help you get.
Kneel or stand on the platform, hands on the bars, arms extended.
Keep your torso upright and lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press up until your elbows are fully extended, shoulders down.
selectorized_biceps_curl: Set the seat so your armpits rest on the top edge of the pad.
Line your elbows up with the machine's pivot.
Curl up without lifting your elbows off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost extended.
selectorized_triceps_extension: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot.
Keep the backs of your upper arms and your elbows on the pad.
Push until your elbows are fully extended.
Return slowly without lifting your elbows off the pad.
selectorized_triceps_press: Set the seat so you start with your elbows bent at about 90°.
Sit tall, chest up, elbows close to your sides.
Push the handles down until your arms are fully extended.
Let the handles rise slowly, without shrugging.
selectorized_leg_press: Set the seat so your knees start at about 90° or a little deeper.
Feet about hip-width on the platform, back and hips against the pad.
Push through your whole foot; stop just short of locking your knees.
Return slowly, keeping your knees in line with your feet.
selectorized_leg_extension: Line your knees up with the machine's pivot, back against the pad.
Set the leg pad on the front of your lower shins, just above your feet.
Extend your knees fully and pause briefly at the top.
Hold the handles to keep your hips on the seat, and lower slowly.
selectorized_leg_curl_seated: Line your knees up with the machine's pivot, back against the pad.
Lower the thigh pad until it's snug; the leg pad sits just above your heels.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Return slowly until your knees are almost extended.
selectorized_leg_curl_lying: Lie face down with your knees just past the edge of the bench, in line with the pivot.
Set the leg pad just above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, keeping your hips on the bench.
Lower slowly until your knees are almost extended.
selectorized_leg_curl_standing: Line your knee up with the machine's pivot, thigh against the pad.
Set the leg pad just above your heel.
Curl your heel toward your glute without moving your thigh.
Lower slowly; finish all reps on that side.
selectorized_hip_abduction: Sit back against the pad with the leg pads on the outside of your knees.
Hold the handles and keep your hips on the seat.
Push your knees apart as far as you can and pause briefly.
Bring them back slowly; don't let the weight stack touch down.
selectorized_hip_adduction: Sit back against the pad with the leg pads on the inside of your knees.
Set the starting width to a stretch you can control.
Squeeze your legs together until the pads meet, then pause briefly.
Open slowly back to the start, keeping your hips on the seat.
selectorized_glute_kickback: Brace on the pad and handles, with your hips level and facing forward.
Push the leg back by squeezing your glute, not by arching your lower back.
Stop when your hip is fully extended; don't swing past it.
Return slowly; finish all reps on that side.
selectorized_calf_raise_standing: Set the shoulder pads so you stand tall under them with your knees extended.
Balls of your feet on the edge of the step, heels free.
Lower your heels for a full stretch, then rise as high as you can.
Pause at the top; don't bounce at the bottom.
selectorized_calf_raise_seated: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform, heels free.
Set the seat or pad so your knee angle stays fixed; only your ankles move.
Use the full range: a deep stretch, then push all the way onto your toes.
Pause at the end of each rep and don't bounce.
selectorized_abdominal_crunch: Set the seat so the pads or handles sit at your upper chest.
Hold on lightly; your abs do the work, not your arms.
Curl your torso down, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly until you feel your abs stretch, without the weight stack touching down.
selectorized_back_extension: Set the seat so the back pad sits across your shoulder blades.
Plant your feet and fasten the belt if the machine has one.
Push back with control until your torso is upright.
Don't arch past upright; return slowly to the start.
selectorized_torso_rotation: Set the start position for one side and lock your legs in place.
Sit tall; turn with your midsection, not by pulling with your arms.
Rotate slowly through a range you can control, without jerking.
Return slowly; finish all reps on that side, then switch.
plate_chest_press: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest.
Back against the pad, shoulder blades back and down.
Press until your arms are extended, without locking your elbows hard.
Load the same plates on both sides and return slowly to a stretch.
plate_chest_press_incline: Set the seat so the handles start at your upper chest.
Keep your back on the pad and your shoulders down.
Press up and forward until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly to a stretch, moving both arms at the same pace.
plate_chest_press_decline: Set the seat so the handles line up with your lower chest.
Back against the pad, shoulder blades pulled back.
Press forward and down until your arms are extended.
Return slowly without letting your shoulders roll forward.
plate_chest_press_one_arm: Set the seat so the handle lines up with your mid-chest.
Hold the frame or the other handle to keep your torso still.
Press until your arm is extended, without twisting your torso.
Return slowly; finish all reps on that side.
plate_shoulder_press: Set the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height.
Back against the pad and abs braced; don't arch.
Press up until your arms are extended, without shrugging.
Lower slowly to shoulder height, moving both arms at the same pace.
plate_row_chest_supported: Set the seat so your chest is on the pad and you reach the handles with arms extended.
Keep your chest on the pad for the whole set.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are extended.
plate_row_high: Lock your thighs under the pad and reach up for the handles.
Keep your chest up for the whole set.
Pull down and back until your hands are near your chest, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end, then return slowly.
plate_row_low: Sit with your chest against the pad and your feet braced.
Start with your arms extended and your chest up.
Pull the handles toward your waist, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly.
plate_row_one_arm: Set the seat so your chest rests on the pad and you can reach the handle.
Keep your chest on the pad and your torso from twisting.
Pull your elbow back past your torso, drawing your shoulder blade back.
Return slowly to a full stretch; finish all reps on that side.
plate_lat_pulldown: Set the thigh pad so your legs are locked in snugly.
Start with your arms extended and your chest up.
Pull down, driving your elbows toward your sides, until your hands reach shoulder height.
Let the handles rise slowly, moving both arms at the same pace.
plate_t_bar_row_supported: Stand on the foot plates and rest your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles and start with your arms extended, back flat.
Pull the handles toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
Keep your chest on the pad; don't jerk the weight with your legs.
plate_hack_squat: Shoulders under the pads, back and hips firm against the backrest.
Feet about shoulder-width in the middle of the platform.
Release the safeties and lower with control, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your whole foot; lock the safeties before you step out.
plate_pendulum_squat: Shoulders under the pads, back and hips firm against the backrest.
Feet about hip-width in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and lower as deep as you can control, knees over your toes.
Drive up through your whole foot; lock the safety before you step out.
plate_belt_squat: Fasten the belt around your hips and stand on the platform.
Feet about shoulder-width; hold the handles for balance only.
Sit down between your heels with your torso upright.
Drive up through your whole foot, knees tracking over your toes.
plate_leverage_squat: Shoulders under the pads, feet slightly in front of you on the platform.
Brace your abs, then release the safety.
Squat down with control, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your whole foot; lock the safety before you step out.
plate_leg_press_45: Back and hips firm on the seat, feet about hip-width on the platform.
Release the safeties and lower with control, stopping before your hips lift off the seat.
Press through your whole foot, knees in line with your feet.
Stop just short of locking your knees; lock the safeties when you finish.
plate_leg_press_horizontal: Set the seat so your knees start at about 90° or a little deeper.
Back and hips against the pad, feet hip-width on the platform.
Push through your whole foot; stop just short of locking your knees.
Return slowly, keeping your knees in line with your feet.
plate_leg_press_one_leg: Use a lighter load and put one foot in the middle of the platform.
Keep your hips on the seat; rest the other foot on the frame.
Lower with control, knee in line with your foot.
Press without locking your knee; finish all reps on that side.
plate_leg_extension: Line your knees up with the machine's pivot, back against the pad.
Set the leg pad on the front of your lower shins, just above your feet.
Extend your knees fully and pause briefly at the top.
Hold the handles to keep your hips on the seat, and lower slowly.
plate_leg_curl: Line your knees up with the machine's pivot.
Set the leg pad just above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes without lifting your hips.
Lower slowly until your knees are almost extended.
plate_hip_thrust: Set the pad across your hips, with your upper back on the backrest.
Feet flat and about hip-width, shins vertical at the top.
Drive through your heels until your shoulders, hips and knees line up.
Keep your ribs down and squeeze your glutes; don't arch to finish.
plate_calf_raise_seated: Set the pad snugly on your lower thighs, just above your knees.
Balls of your feet on the edge of the step, heels free.
Release the safety and lower your heels for a full stretch.
Lift your heels as high as you can, pause, and lower slowly.
plate_calf_raise_standing: Shoulders under the pads, standing tall with your knees extended.
Balls of your feet on the edge of the step, heels free.
Lower your heels for a full stretch, then rise as high as you can.
Pause at the top; don't bounce at the bottom.
plate_biceps_curl: Set the seat so your armpits rest on the top edge of the pad.
Line your elbows up with the machine's pivot.
Curl up without lifting your elbows off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost extended; don't drop the weight.
plate_triceps_dip: Set the seat so you start with your elbows bent at about 90°.
Sit tall, chest up, elbows close to your sides.
Push the handles down until your arms are fully extended.
Let the handles rise slowly, without shrugging or rocking your torso.
trap_bar_deadlift: Step inside the bar and stand centered, handles beside your mid-foot.
Push your hips back and down, chest up, and grip the middle of the handles.
Brace, then push the floor away until you stand tall.
Lower the bar along the same path, keeping your back flat.
